summary: During a violent clash after settlers entered the Burqa area, Israeli settlers fired live ammunition; Qusai Jamal Matan, 19, was killed and another Palestinian was injured by shrapnel.
discovery_sources: UN OCHA Protection of Civilians 25 July–7 August 2023; Times of Israel; AP legal follow-up
